purpose: Calculates the theoretical (equilibrium) solubility product of AlN inclusions in steel, i.e., the product of dissolved aluminum and nitrogen contents ([pctAl]·[pctN]) as a function of temperature.
applicability_conditions: Applies to the theoretical concentration of AlN inclusions formed in the 1#–3# steel samples; equation (6) has intercept 7.200, between equation (5) (7.225) and equation (7) (7.187). No explicit temperature range is given.

symbols.meaning: mass percentage (concentration) of dissolved aluminum in the steel
mass percentage (concentration) of dissolved nitrogen in the steel
coefficient of the 1/T term in the AlN solubility-product relation
constant (intercept) in the AlN solubility-product relation

unmapped: The theoretical concentration of AlN inclusions formed in samples 1# to 3# is expressed by equations (5), (6) and (7), which share the same -15851/T term but differ in the intercept (7.225, 7.200, 7.187).
Interaction coefficients used for the calculation are shown in Table 4 (references 23–39).
